searchText: Hey guys, another quick question. Apologies if this is obvious, but in the last Holesky call there was talk about allocations and requests. As we are planning on running a faucet on Holesky, should we be requesting an allocation of tokens? *FYI we have committed to running a portion of validators from genesis* Another quick question: is the validator set permissioned or do we "just" have a beacon chain deposit contract such that we can join later?
